# Hosea Chapter 8 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 331v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HOS_008_page_001.jpg

---

**8:4** They made-kings himliku but-not from-me lo mimmeni; they-made-princes hesiru and-I-did-not know lo yadati; their-silver kaspam and-their-gold u-zehavm they-made asu for-themselves idols atsabbim, so-that lema'an it-may-be-cut-off yikkaret.

**8:7** For wind ruach they-sow yizra'u and-whirlwind sufatah they-will-reap yiqtsoru; standing-grain qamah has-no ein lo stalk tsemach; the-bud tzemach will-not produce ya'aseh flour qemach; if-it-does produce, strangers zarim will-swallow-it yivla'uhu.

**8:14** And-Yisra'el forgot vayyishkach his-Maker osehu and-built vayyiven temples hekhalot; and-Yehudah multiplied hirbah fortified betsurot cities arim; and-I-will-send veshillachti fire on-his-cities and-it-will-devour her-fortresses armenoteyha.

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

The formal rendering preserves the Hebrew structure of Hosea 8, maintaining the prophet's distinctive voice — combining domestic imagery with cosmic theology.

*— LOGOS*
